title: Celestial Alchemist
description: A woman in traditional Indian attire stands at a table covered with a deep blue cloth, gesturing toward a glowing green potion bottle labeled 'Elixir of Life'. The scene is filled with magical and astronomical elements including a smiling comet, a smiling Saturn-like planet, floating potion bottles, scrolls, an open book with a quill, and a starry night sky visible through an arched window.
prompt: A mystical Indian female alchemist wearing a white and orange sari stands beside a table with a blue velvet cloth, reaching toward a large glowing green potion labeled 'Elixir of Life'. The room is an ancient stone chamber with an arched window showing a vibrant cosmic night sky with swirling nebulae, smiling stars, a smiling comet with a rainbow tail, and a large smiling Saturn-like planet. Various magical potion bottles, scrolls, an open book with a green quill, and alchemical tools are arranged on the table. A glowing lantern hangs from the ceiling. Whimsical, colorful, and detailed fantasy illustration.
